oracle-l5r-2950: Halls of the Forgotten (Crab Stronghold): "Reaction: After another player's Battle action targets your Berserker: Delay its effects on him until after this battle ends." The targeted-by-action reaction window exists (TargetedActionReactions.cs, ReactionTriggers.TargetedByAction) and per-kind negations exist (MatchState.NegatedEffects: bow / destroy / move / all, and DelayedDestruction.cs's delay-destroy, which Spirit of the Berserker uses for the destruction kind alone), but there is no way to delay ALL of an action's effects on one card. Every ability's effects are hard-coded in the RunAbilityEffects switch by ability id, with no per-target effect list; most bows, dishonors, Force modifiers and moves set card fields directly (there is no shared choke point -- ActionEffectTracking.cs notes that a bow is not even recorded), so "its effects on him" cannot be captured now and replayed after the battle ends without either replaying the action's effects on other cards and its Honor/Gold consequences, or missing effects. Building it needs an effect-recording layer (each effect an action applies to a card recorded as a deferred, re-validated closure keyed by the affected card, replayed when the battle ends -- probably by routing every card-mutating helper through one Apply(effect) funnel first), or a per-ability re-execution filtered to one target. Delaying only bow/destroy/move (the existing negation kinds) would be a partial card, which the pass forbids.
